description: This file defines the LruGrainDirectoryCache class, which implements an in-memory cache for grain directory entries using an LRU eviction policy. It provides methods for adding, updating, removing, and looking up grain addresses and their versions, and exposes a collection of key-value pairs representing the cache contents.

classes.name: LruGrainDirectoryCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing grain directory entries with LRU eviction, supporting add, remove, lookup, and enumeration operations.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds a new entry or updates an existing entry in the cache with the specified grain address and version.

methods.name: Remove (by GrainId)
methods.description: Removes an entry from the cache based on the grain ID.

methods.name: Remove (by GrainAddress)
methods.description: Removes an entry from the cache matching the provided grain address.

methods.name: LookUp
methods.description: Retrieves the grain address and version associated with a given grain ID, returning true if found.
